marketing.module_payments_description: Scan barcodes, hold orders, apply discounts, process returns and split payments. Accept cash and supported mada, Visa, Mastercard and digital wallet payments.
marketing.module_shifts_description: Open the business date, check in cashiers, record drawer cash in and out, and reconcile shortages and overages at shift close.
marketing.module_catalog_description: Manage product photos, categories, units of measure, barcodes and prices. Build shop-specific menus, combos and offers.
marketing.module_inventory_description: Manage purchasing and receipts. Track raw materials, packaging and finished goods. Review stock counts, variances and adjustments.
marketing.module_kitchen_description: Receive finished goods from a central kitchen, transfer stock between shops and track waste, damage and leftovers.
marketing.module_customers_description: Use customer-specific prices and credit terms for dealers, schools and cafés. Ask about loyalty options and settlement workflows for your rollout.
marketing.module_accounting_description: Map payment methods and business events to the chart of accounts. Generate store-level daily journal vouchers and drill down to receipts.
marketing.module_reporting_description: Compare sales by shop, hour, terminal, cashier, product and category. Review payments, discounts, returns and voids, and export supported reports.
marketing.module_branches_description: Manage locations, register terminals and assign role-based access. Configure supervisor approvals for actions such as stock adjustments.
marketing.module_ai_description: Ask plain-language questions about sales with the optional reporting module. Filter by date and location and export supported results.
marketing.module_integrations_description: Discuss delivery-provider workflows, payment terminals, receipt printers, cash drawers, barcode scanners, scales and external ERP integration.
marketing.screenshot_dashboard_description: Review net sales, order counts, average order value and hourly activity across shops.
marketing.screenshot_stock_description: Review stock by shop and track ingredients, packaging and finished goods.
marketing.screenshot_journal_description: Review daily journal vouchers by store and trace totals to source receipts.

marketing.faq_setup_1_answer: Discuss Windows or Android POS devices with Ceevora. Share your payment terminal, printer, cash drawer or scanner models to confirm compatibility.
marketing.faq_setup_2_answer: A configured till can record core counter sales locally and sync them when the connection returns. Online refunds, reports, and provider integrations require connectivity.
marketing.faq_setup_3_answer: Yes. Ceevora POS supports Arabic and English interfaces, including a right-to-left interface and bilingual catalog names.
marketing.faq_operations_1_question: Can each branch have its own menu?
marketing.faq_operations_1_answer: Yes. Configure menus by shop, track stock by location and compare sales across locations in the management console.
marketing.faq_operations_2_question: Can I manage more than one shop?
marketing.faq_operations_2_answer: Yes. Organize tills under stores and branches, scope staff access by location, and use branch and store filters in sales reporting.
marketing.faq_operations_3_question: Can I handle orders for business customers?
marketing.faq_operations_3_answer: The back-office workflow supports customer prices, credit terms, standing orders, and production lists by kitchen.
marketing.faq_operations_4_question: Can I receive delivery app orders?
marketing.faq_operations_4_answer: The delivery inbox supports enabled providers. Provider activation, store configuration, and POS product mapping are required.
marketing.faq_permissions_1_question: Can I give staff different permissions?
marketing.faq_permissions_1_answer: Yes. Staff and administrators can be given role-based permissions and access to assigned locations.
marketing.faq_permissions_2_question: How are refunds and voids approved?
marketing.faq_permissions_2_answer: Cashiers can look up a sale and request manager approval. These reversals require an online connection.
marketing.faq_permissions_3_question: How do we plan for Saudi e-invoicing?
marketing.faq_permissions_3_answer: Share your ZATCA requirements with Ceevora to confirm the supported configuration and onboarding scope for your business.
marketing.faq_reporting_1_question: Can sales use up recipe ingredients?
marketing.faq_reporting_1_answer: Yes. When Inventory is enabled and a product has a recipe, checkout can deduct its ingredient quantities using the configured units.
marketing.faq_reporting_2_question: Can I track expiry dates and stock counts?
marketing.faq_reporting_2_answer: Yes. Inventory includes batch and expiry tracking, physical counts, and variance review.
marketing.faq_reporting_3_answer: Standard sales reports include daily sales, categories, promotions, and VAT, with CSV or Excel export. Sales Summary has a PDF download.
